# Honest Weight Loss Reviews

> Independent reviews of behaviour-change weight-loss apps and meal plans for adults in the United States (18+). No promises about results, no testimonials, no invented figures. Every price and trial term is checked against official pages or labelled "To be verified".

## Site

- [Home](https://wlreviews.github.io/)
- [About and disclosure](https://wlreviews.github.io/about.html)

- [WeightWatchers vs Noom: an honest comparison](https://wlreviews.github.io/ww-vs-noom.html) — Hub comparison. Published 2026-11-20; full text live, about 5,350 words, 18 FAQs. Prices and trial terms checked 20 November 2026.

Published 2026-11-22; about 4,310 words, 8 FAQs. Prices checked 22 November 2026.

- [Noom Food Color System: Green, Yellow, and Orange Explained](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-food-color-system.html) — Green, yellow, orange — sorted by calorie density, not good or bad. 30% green, 45% yellow, 25% orange, and no food off limits. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,543 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.

CBT Lessons Explained](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-behavior-change.html) — Daily CBT lessons, 5–15 minutes: triggers, emotional eating, “head hunger,” plateaus — the method behind the program. Support, Check-Ins, Limits](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-coaching.html) — Your coach looks at your food log, suggests foods, and helps through plateaus — included at no extra cost. One-to-one? Not stated. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,383 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.

The tracker sorts it green, yellow, or orange, with a daily allotment. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,410 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.

Monthly: $70 against $9.99. What the extra $159 a year buys: a coach and daily CBT lessons. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,125 words, 6 FAQs. Prices checked 22 November 2026.

Exercise starts at 200 steps a day. Plans from $70 a month. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,134 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.
- [Noom Diet Plan: What It Is (and What It Isn't) 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-diet-plan.html) — Noom has no set meal plan. Instead you get a daily calorie range, a color system for every food, and a recipe database — plus a coach and daily lessons. Published 2026-11-22; about 2,045 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 22 November 2026.
- [Noom Daily Lessons: What You Learn Each Day 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-daily-lessons.html) — Daily CBT lessons, around 5–15 minutes: triggers, emotional eating, “head hunger,” plateaus — what the lessons cover, and what they leave out. Published 2026-11-23; about 2,200 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.
- [Noom for Emotional Eaters: What the Lessons Teach 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-for-emotional-eating.html) — Three of the seven things Noom teaches speak to emotional eating: triggers, stress eating, and what to do instead of snacking. Lessons, not therapy. Published 2026-11-23; about 2,305 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.
- [Noom for Busy Professionals: What It Asks of You 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-for-busy-professionals.html) — One lesson of around 5–15 minutes a day, a log you can do at night, an optional weigh-in, and steps starting at 200. What it asks of you, in minutes. Published 2026-11-23; about 2,124 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.
- [Noom for People Who Have Tried Diets Before 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-for-people-who-tried-diets.html) — Not another set of rules: daily CBT lessons, a coach, and food colors — no food off limits, no set meal plan. What is different, and what is the same. Published 2026-11-23; about 2,087 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.
- [Noom for Vegetarians: How the Colors Work 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-for-vegetarians.html) — Noom works the same way for vegetarians: colors sort food by calorie density, not by whether it comes from animals. Green is vegetables and whole grains; yellow is starches, avocado, and legumes. Published 2026-11-23; about 1,958 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.
- [Noom vs WeightWatchers Cost: Which Is Cheaper? 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-vs-weightwatchers-cost.html) — WW Core is $5 for the first month, then $10 a month, against $209 a year for Noom. What each price buys, and the Core+ $10 first-month offer that ends 4 December 2026 and renews at $20 a month. Published 2026-11-27; about 2,207 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 27 November 2026.
- [Noom vs MyFitnessPal: Free Trial and Features Compared 2026](https://wlreviews.github.io/noom-vs-myfitnesspal-free-trial.html) — Both trials last 7 days, and they work differently. Noom’s 7-day initial trial starts your plan; MyFitnessPal’s 7-day free trial gives first-time users Premium. What each trial includes, and what happens when it ends. Published 2026-11-23; about 2,299 words, 6 FAQs. Facts checked 23 November 2026.

## Planned articles

- WeightWatchers vs MyFitnessPal: points or free tracking?

## Method

- Each comparison covers three options, judged on the same five points: price and trial terms, daily use, coaching and support, food tracking, cancelling.
- No star ratings. No weight-loss promises. Affiliate disclosure on every page. Adults 18+ only.
